strings.무슨 일로 부르셨나요?: What did you call me here for?
strings.이런…, 안부 전할 틈도 없이 바로 본론을 물어보는 건가?: Goodness... Straight to business without even time for a greeting?
strings.성격이 조금 급해진 느낌이야. 처음 봤을 땐 이 정도는 아니었던 것 같은: You seem a little more impatient than before. You weren't quite like this when we first met.
Then I'll get right to it.
strings.오로라의 숲 관리자이자 페어리인 플라리가 내게 도움을 청했다네. 어떻게: Flari, a fairy who tends Aurora Forest, has asked me for help. I came to know the fairies through a turn of events, and we've been friends for a long time.
strings.어려운 일이 있어도 좀처럼 도움을 요청하지 않는 플라리가 직접 그런 걸: Flari rarely asks for help, even in difficult times. For her to reach out personally, something serious must be happening. I suspect it concerns Queen Aurora, the ruler of the forest.
Put simply, she's a queen of flowers who loves beautiful things.
Born as a spirit, she oversees the fairies and tends the forest. I've heard she sometimes takes her pursuit of beauty a little too far.
strings.(문득 조에가 생각나는데….): (For some reason, that reminds me of Zoe...)
Understood. I'll take care of it.
Be careful when dealing with Queen Aurora.
She has a rather unusual personality, but she was never particularly wicked.
Go to Aurora Forest and hear the details there.
strings.입구에 페어리인 플라리가 있네. 찾아가면 오로라 여왕에게 무슨 일이 있는: The fairy Flari is at the entrance. Find her, and she'll tell you exactly what's happening with Queen Aurora.
Ah, you can reach Aurora Forest through Coral Forest.
strings.가기 전에 또 조심해야 할 점이나 그런 건 없을까요?: Before I go, is there anything else I should watch out for?
strings.흠…. 그것도 확실히 페어리 플라리에게 물어보면 될 거야. 그럼 행운을: Hmm... You can ask Flari about that as well. Good luck, then. Have a safe trip.
strings.(흐음, 행운을 빌어야 할 정도의 일인가?): (Hmm. Is this serious enough that I'll need luck?)
Still, that adventurer seems rather unsettled. I wonder if everything is all right.
strings.저기, 아인스트 님의 말씀을 듣고 오신 분인가요? 모험가…님?: Excuse me, are you the one Einst sent? The... adventurer?
strings.네, 맞아요. 페어리 플라리 맞으시죠? 아인스트 님께 도움을 요청했다고: Yes, that's me. You're Flari the fairy, right? I heard you asked Einst for help.
strings.아아, 고마워요. 기다렸답니다. 얼굴도 모르는 제 부탁을 받고 이 먼길까: Oh, thank you. I've been waiting for you. I'm so grateful that you came all this way at the request of someone you've never even met.
strings.숲으로 오는 길이 조금 험하긴 했지만, 도착하고 보니 기분이 좋아지는 것: The road through the forest was a little rough, but now that I'm here, I feel better.
Isn't it lovely? Aurora Forest really is the most peaceful place in the world.
...No, it's a little different from that...
Hmm? I'm not sure what you mean.
strings.아, 아무것도 아니에요. 그래서 제가 뭘 도와드리면 될까요? 아인스트 님: Oh, it's nothing. So what can I help you with? Einst told me to come here and hear the details.
strings.네, 그러면 말씀드릴게요. 오로라 숲은 꽃의 여왕 오로라의 권능으로 탄생: All right, I'll explain. Aurora Forest was created through the power of Aurora, Queen of Flowers.
strings.숲의 주민들은 이 숲이 영원하길 바라며 이곳을 오로라의 숲으로 부르기로: The forest's inhabitants decided to name it Aurora Forest, hoping it would last forever. To be honest, the other suggestions were dreadful...
strings.오로라 여왕은 천성이 아름다운 것을 좋아하고 깔끔하지 못한 것을 경멸하는: Queen Aurora naturally loves beautiful things and despises anything untidy.
strings.성격도 도도하고 맘에 들지 않는 건 그냥 바보 취급하거나 무시하는 경향이: She's also rather haughty. She tends to dismiss anything she dislikes as foolish, or simply ignore it.
strings.부딪힐 일이 없으면 문제될 부분도 없었어요. 사실 여왕님을 만날 일이 거: As long as we didn't cross her path, that wasn't a problem. We hardly ever saw the Queen, anyway.
But something must have happened to her, because she started singing.
strings.노래에 무슨 문제라도 있는 건가요?: Is there something wrong with her singing?
strings.그게 노래를 지독하게 못 부르세요. 노래를 못 부르는 사람은 많아요. 하: She's terribly bad at it. Lots of people sing badly, but that's not the real problem. Her voice carries frighteningly well.
strings.아침, 저녁, 새벽 상관없이 깨어있을 때면 계속 부르시는데, 정원을 넘어: Morning, evening, before dawn... Whenever she's awake, she sings. Her voice carries beyond the garden and fills the entire forest. It practically shakes the trees.
strings.정작 본인은 그런 걸 모르시나봐요. 계속 부르시는 걸 보면…. 후우, 그: She doesn't seem to realize it, since she keeps on singing... Sigh. Everyone is so stressed by it that they can barely function.
Some of the residents have even started behaving strangely...
Even the good-natured unicorns are suffering nervous breakdowns.
strings.진짜 신께선 너무하세요. 오로라 여왕께 왜 그런 발성의 재능만 주신걸까요: The gods really are cruel. Why give Queen Aurora such a powerful voice and nothing else? They could have given her a pleasant tone too...
strings.숲의 평화를 위해서라도 오로라 여왕의 노래를 멈춰야 해요. 제발 도와주세: For the sake of peace in the forest, we have to stop Queen Aurora's singing. Please help us!
Please listen to me, Lady Aurora.
strings.도대체 왜, 예전에는 관심도 없던 노래를 시작하신 건가요?: Why did you suddenly start singing when you never showed any interest in it before?
strings.(오로라가 잠시 머뭇거리다가 입을 연다. 이런 말을 꺼내는 것이 조금 부: (Aurora hesitates before speaking. She seems a little embarrassed to bring it up.)
It's because of a human man.
strings.네? 네? 오로라 님이 다른 분에게 관심이 있으시다구요?: What? What? Lady Aurora, you're interested in someone else?
strings.세상에, 세상에…. 원래 자신을 제외한 다른 존재에겐 신경도 안쓰시고 그: Oh my goodness... You, who never cared about anyone but yourself and treated everyone else as servants, are interested in a man? A human man, at that?
You never even spare humans a thought. How did this happen...?
S-stop it. Be quiet!! I didn't expect it either!
strings.하지만, 정말 멋지고 강하고 자상한 모습에 어쩔 수 없었다고!!: But he was so handsome, strong, and kind. I couldn't help it!!
strings.대체 어떤 사람이기에 여왕님이 그렇게 마음이 흔들린 거에요?: What sort of person could move your heart so much, Your Majesty?
Exactly. Who on earth is this man...?
strings.레, 레비 아렌스라는 사람이야. 혹시 거기 모험가 인간, 레비 아렌스를: H-his name is Levi Arens. You there, human adventurer. Do you know Levi Arens?
Yes, I know him. He works for the royal court of Elias.
It's a kingdom on the Jiendia continent.
The Jiendia continent, captain of the Elias royal guard... That's useful information.
Thank you. I'd like to visit if I ever get the chance. Thank you, human adventurer.
strings.그런데 레비가 어떻게 여왕님을 알고 있는 거죠? 이곳까지 올 일이 있는: But how does Levi know you, Your Majesty? Did he have a reason to come all the way here?
strings.그가 어째서 여기에 온 건지 알 수 없지만…. 예전에 용무 때문에 잠시: I don't know why he was here... A while ago, I briefly left the forest on business and found myself in danger.
I see. He would never walk past someone in trouble.
strings.그 일 이후로 자꾸 생각이 났어. 인간 남자를 떠올리다니 나도 참 이상하: After that, I couldn't stop thinking about him. Strange, isn't it? Me, thinking about a human man.
Then I remembered a melody he had been humming and started singing it myself.
strings.그 노래를 그렇게 잘 부르면 언젠가 레비 아렌스를 만나 들려줄 수도 있을: I thought that if I learned to sing it well, I might be able to sing it for Levi Arens someday.
I'm sorry. I thought I was only practicing. I had no idea I was shaking the whole forest...
strings.괜찮아요. 오로라 님. 그 인간 남자에게 반해서 잘 보이고 싶은 마음에: It's all right, Lady Aurora. If you started practicing because you fell for that human man and wanted to impress him, well...
strings.그런 사정이라면 제가 도와드릴게요?: In that case, perhaps I can help?
strings.네가 뭘 어떻게 돕겠다는 거야?: How exactly do you intend to help?
strings.제 친구 중에 노래를 잘 부르는 친구가 있어요. 그 친구의 방법으로 노래: I have a friend who's a wonderful singer. Her teaching methods have helped lots of people learn to sing well.
With lessons from my friend, I'm sure you could do well too, Your Majesty.
strings.여왕님이 가진 힘이라면 정원과 숲에 피해를 주지 않고도 노래를 부를 수: With your power, I believe you can sing without harming the garden or the forest.
Ahem. Well, if you insist, I'll try to hold back.
strings.좋아요, 그러면 결정된 거에요? 그때까지 노래 부르는 거 조금만 참아주세: Wonderful. Then it's settled? Please refrain from singing just until then.
I'll arrange things with my friend as quickly as possible and let you know.
Phew. Thank you so much, adventurer! Everything worked out thanks to you.
strings.일이 잘 끝났다니 다행이네요. 플라리, 나중에 오로라 님께 살며시 알려주: I'm glad it ended well. Flari, please quietly mention something to Lady Aurora later.
Levi likes considerate people more than people who can sing well.
strings.(그러면 이제 돌아가볼까? 그런데 왠지 모르게 오로라 여왕님을 자주 뵈어: (Shall I head back now? Though for some reason, I have a feeling I'll be seeing Queen Aurora quite often...)
